export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug: vedarma-wellness-private-limited) shows 133 records detected, latest cargo 2025-09-23; exact row: "2025-09-23 | VEDARMA WELLNESS PRIVATE LIMITED | IP BERIKZHAN | HERBAL PRODUCTS : THRIPHALA TABLET | DELHI AIR CARGO, India | ALMATY, KAZAKHSTAN | 30049011 | 2595556". Same B/L 2595556 covers 5 line items (THRIPHALA TABLET, EVANOVA CAP, MAHARASNADI KWATHAM, SAHACHARADI KWATHAM, SUKUMARAM KWATHAM), all HS 30049011, destination Almaty, Kazakhstan. Ports: DELHI AIR CARGO (5), ALMATY (5). Counter check: page header claims "Total Shipments 133 Records detected" but only 5 shipment rows were actually rendered in the free view — the 133 figure is unverified; the 5 dated rows are the verified evidence.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: real outbound air-cargo shipments from Delhi to Almaty (Kazakhstan) dated 2025-09-23, HS 30049011 (ayurvedic/herbal medicaments), B/L 2595556, consignee IP BERIKZHAN. This matches the declared HS 300490 (the declared second code 330590 — hair preparations — was not seen in the visible rows; no HS correction needed since 300490 is confirmed and 330590 is not contradicted, just unobserved). Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be verified: DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection refused on both attempts, and volza.com, eximpedia.app and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic supply. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in free views; not invented). Second slug variant 'vedarma-wellness-pvt-ltd' returned an empty page (no records), so the canonical slug is the '-private-limited' form. Role classification not in scope of this task, but note the counterparties listed (IP BERIKZHAN, IP SMASHEV, IP BERIKZHAN ARJUN LOGISTICS) are Kazakhstan consignees, consistent with an exporter of herbal products rather than a trader of the claimed 'oil & gas / chemicals' industry label — the industry_claimed field appears mislabelled relative to actual cargo (herbal medicaments).
